eval_feedback.overall: v2 regressed on this eval relative to v1 (which caught note-slugify.ts). The miss isn't explained by the v2 diff itself — v2's checklist table does list 'a same-named helper that duplicates logic already present in a sibling use-case/file' as a row, but has no row that captures 'utility placed in a cross-cutting folder but only consumed by one module', which was the actual shape of this violation. v1's prose rule ('a shared utility used only by one feature') stayed in v2 unchanged, so the miss looks like run-to-run variance at n=1 rather than a v2-introduced defect — but the checklist table in v2 may be inadvertently narrowing attention to its listed rows at the expense of the prose bullets below it. Worth re-running both versions 3x each before concluding anything.
